items.title: United States
kv: GENIUS supplies redemption, reserve, holder-priority and lawful-order mechanisms without federal insurance or guarantee. DTC and payment-system rules allocate authoritative-record correction and finality within their own scopes. Securities, custody, insolvency, forfeiture, sanctions and state commercial-law remedies remain object- and entity-specific.
Freeze or burn capability, operational reversal, restitution, insolvency priority, deposit insurance and sovereign backstop are not interchangeable remedies.

items.title: Japan
kv: BOJ-NET finality limits reversal but does not eliminate later compensation or restitution. Ordinary JPYSC follows trust assets and redemption law with no deposit insurance; lent JPYSC follows SBI VC Trade's consumption-loan obligation and can be lost in its insolvency because the units are outside customer-asset segregation. DCJPY follows the issuing bank's deposit and resolution regime if its stated classification governs; future retail or wholesale CBDC loss and reversal rules remain undecided.
Liquidity support, operational continuity, deposit protection, trust segregation, intermediary lending and terminal loss absorption are different mechanisms.

QR payout and user-error rules remain bank and route specific.
Regulatory exit obligations do not prove every customer has been repaid; bank transfer error, crypto custody loss and clearing default require different correction routes.

items.title: European Union
kv: MiCA, e-money, banking, investment-service, custody, securities, CSD, TARGET and national property and insolvency rules allocate different remedies. An erroneous chain transfer, issuer liability-book error, false whitepaper, reserve-bank failure, CASP custody shortfall and TARGET error would engage different actors. SG-FORGE's stated segregation and bankruptcy-remoteness remain issuer disclosures requiring instrument and national-law verification; no observed failure supplied a tested waterfall.
EU authorization does not create a single loss waterfall, and a chain record does not by itself decide legal title, redemption or settlement correction.

items.title: Singapore
kv: Correction can involve provider-ledger controls, a compensating blockchain transfer or issuer freeze where technically and legally available, customer-asset trust administration, bank recall and fraud procedures, designated-system finality, police tracing/freezing, confiscation and insolvency distribution. The Finality Act protects qualifying designated-system transfers once final under system rules, while PSA safeguarding creates books and trust structures without eliminating shortfall, custody or insolvency risk.
Irreversible technical transfer, legal finality, asset freeze, recovered proceeds and customer restitution are different clocks with different authorities and loss bearers.

items.title: Australia
kv: RITS rules protect final ESA settlement against zero-hour unwinding and provide member suspension and default procedures. The future DAF regime authorizes asset-holding and transactional and settlement standards, contemplates client-money trust treatment and permits omnibus token locations when internal accounting identifies clients. Actual customer recovery still depends on final standards, firm licence, platform rules, custody terms and insolvency law.
RITS payment finality, platform accounting, asset segregation, restitution, issuer redemption and government or deposit protection are different remedies.

items.title: New Zealand
kv: FMI law protects ESAS and NZClear settlement completed under their rules; unfunded NZClear instructions can remain pending and fail rather than settle. DCS compensates eligible protected deposits up to NZD 100,000 per depositor per deposit taker. FSPR and retail DRS provide registration and complaint routes, while contract, trust, property and insolvency law can govern customer claims. SFO's Dasset investigation closed for insufficient evidence of serious or complex fraud, without proving customer recovery.
Settlement finality, failed instruction, dispute resolution, deposit compensation, proprietary claim, insolvency distribution, restitution and criminal disposition are different outcomes.

items.title: Brazil
kv: Resolution 520 assigns scoped provider responsibility for agreed settlement, asset legitimacy, transaction-data security and customer-operation records; requires individualized customer cash accounts and separation of customer virtual assets; and requires custody discontinuity and foreign-insolvency arrangements. BCB says virtual-asset transaction risk remains with the parties. STR/SPI rules protect settled central-bank-money entries, not virtual-asset price, issuer solvency or recovery. For the CSD BR mirror, CSD BR retains participant authorization, freeze and clawback controls and its own systems remain the official record.

Segregation, a proof of reserves, MPT freeze or clawback, correction of the official CSD record, seizure, recognized claim, issuer redemption, judicial distribution and customer receipt are different remedies and clocks.

items.title: Ghana
kv: Correction may involve a bank or PSP alert and account decision, FIC suspicious-transaction record, GhIPSS process, VASP or custodian ledger, key control, blockchain state, sandbox condition or termination, regulator action, asset freeze or seizure and court disposition. pictures.title: One question across the jurisdictions
pictures.sub: Read across a country; each labelled cell opens its complete source-bearing card. No score or adoption rank is calculated.

cells.text: GENIUS supplies redemption, reserve, holder-priority and lawful-order mechanisms without federal insurance or guarantee. DTC and payment-system rules allocate authoritative-record correction and finality within their own scopes. Securities, custody, insolvency, forfeiture, sanctions and state commercial-law remedies remain object- and entity-specific.
cells.label: GENIUS supplies redemption, reserve, holder-priority and lawful-order mechanisms without federal insurance or guarantee. DTC and payment-system rules allocate authoritative-record correction and finality within their own scopes. Securities, custody, insolvency, forfeiture, sanctions and state commercial-law remedies remain object- and entity-specific.

cells.text: Freeze or burn capability, operational reversal, restitution, insolvency priority, deposit insurance and sovereign backstop are not interchangeable remedies.
cells.label: Freeze or burn capability, operational reversal, restitution, insolvency priority, deposit insurance and sovereign backstop are not interchangeable remedies.

cells.text: Future CASS 17 custody protection depends on control and asset classification; self-custody remains outside and some specified-investment cryptoassets initially route through CASS 6. A consented settlement float can sit outside the CASS 17 trust, and overseas insolvency can change recovery.
cells.label: Future CASS 17 custody protection depends on control and asset classification; self-custody remains outside and some specified-investment cryptoassets initially route through CASS 6. A consented settlement float can sit outside the CASS 17 trust, and overseas insolvency can change recovery.

cells.text: Client-asset rules do not guarantee recovery, settle underlying property title or erase the insolvency law of an overseas entity.
cells.label: Client-asset rules do not guarantee recovery, settle underlying property title or erase the insolvency law of an overseas entity.

cells.text: BOJ-NET finality limits reversal but does not eliminate later compensation or restitution. Ordinary JPYSC follows trust assets and redemption law with no deposit insurance; lent JPYSC follows SBI VC Trade's consumption-loan obligation and can be lost in its insolvency because the units are outside customer-asset segregation. DCJPY follows the issuing bank's deposit and resolution regime if its stated classification governs; future retail or wholesale CBDC loss and reversal rules remain undecided.

cells.text: Correction can involve CASP books, blockchain control, bank procedures, FinSurv regularization, FSCA/FIC action and court or tribunal disposition. FinSurv's 10%-40% settlement mechanism concerns exchange-control contraventions; SAMOS finality governs the accepted fiat entry. Neither mechanism makes a failed crypto claimant whole.

cells.text: Technical reversal, record correction, license action, regulatory settlement, asset freeze, seizure, insolvency recognition and customer restitution are separate clocks.
cells.label: Technical reversal, record correction, license action, regulatory settlement, asset freeze, seizure, insolvency recognition and customer restitution are separate clocks.

cells.text: Correction can involve a bank or NIP dispute record, eNaira ledger, designated VASP account, provider ledger, custody or key control, blockchain entry, SEC or CBN action, freeze or seizure, and court or tribunal disposition. cNGN terms warn that blockchain broadcasts are usually irreversible, require the merchant to send to the issuer's redemption address and assign address-error loss to the user; only after burn does WrappedCBDC initiate naira return to the designated bank account. RTGS finality fixes the accepted fiat entry but does not reverse the token transfer or make a claimant whole.

cells.text: Technical reversal, bank adjustment, regulatory warning, licence action, asset freeze, seizure, adjudication, insolvency claim, recovery and restitution are separate clocks.
cells.label: Technical reversal, bank adjustment, regulatory warning, licence action, asset freeze, seizure, adjudication, insolvency claim, recovery and restitution are separate clocks.

cells.text: Correction may involve provider books, consumer attribution, bank or PSP records, blockchain state, CBK/CMA intervention, freezing or seizure, statutory management, liquidation and court disposition. Stablecoin reserves must be insolvency remote and a liquidating licensee must discharge consumer-fund liabilities as soon as practicable before ranking other creditors, while KEPSS finality fixes the accepted fiat entry.

Stablecoin reserves must be insolvency remote and a liquidating licensee must discharge consumer-fund liabilities as soon as practicable before ranking other creditors, while KEPSS finality fixes the accepted fiat entry.

cells.text: Ledger correction, payment adjustment, regulatory intervention, asset freeze, seizure, statutory management, insolvency priority, recovery and restitution have separate clocks; none guarantees full recovery.
cells.label: Ledger correction, payment adjustment, regulatory intervention, asset freeze, seizure, statutory management, insolvency priority, recovery and restitution have separate clocks; none guarantees full recovery.

cells.text: Correction may involve a bank or PSP alert and account decision, FIC suspicious-transaction record, GhIPSS process, VASP or custodian ledger, key control, blockchain state, sandbox condition or termination, regulator action, asset freeze or seizure and court disposition. The official risk assessment documents monitoring, account restriction or closure and referral, but does not join those steps to adjudication or final customer restitution. Sandbox exit rules require customer assets and obligations to be addressed, while GIS finality fixes the accepted fiat entry.

cells.text: Technical reversal, record correction, orderly exit, licence action, freeze, seizure, adjudication, insolvency claim, recovery and restitution have separate clocks; none guarantees full recovery.
cells.label: Technical reversal, record correction, orderly exit, licence action, freeze, seizure, adjudication, insolvency claim, recovery and restitution have separate clocks; none guarantees full recovery.

cells.text: Correction may involve a bank or intermediary account, VATP or custodian ledger, token contract, blockchain state, stablecoin redemption, RTGS or FPS instruction, licence action, tribunal review, insolvency process or court order. CHATS finality fixes the settled fiat entry, while stablecoin reserve and insolvency rights govern a different private claim.

cells.text: Technical reversal, ledger correction, token burn, par redemption, licence suspension, reserve liquidation, shortfall claim, adjudication, recovery and restitution have separate clocks.
cells.label: Technical reversal, ledger correction, token burn, par redemption, licence suspension, reserve liquidation, shortfall claim, adjudication, recovery and restitution have separate clocks.

cells.text: Correction may occur through wallet and credential controls, bank/provider books, e-CNY technical records, conventional payment-system procedures, provider complaint and compensation mechanisms, regulatory freeze/action, deposit insurance/liquidation or criminal/judicial recovery. The nonbank framework requires complaints, loss-compensation and exit plans; one police case records full CNY 200,000 recovery. No public e-CNY 2.0 rulebook or observed national recovery series joins these layers.

No public e-CNY 2.0 rulebook or observed national recovery series joins these layers.

cells.text: Technical adjustment, payment reversal, final interbank settlement, provider compensation, insured payout, confiscation and victim restitution have distinct clocks and authorities.
cells.label: Technical adjustment, payment reversal, final interbank settlement, provider compensation, insured payout, confiscation and victim restitution have distinct clocks and authorities.

cells.text: Correction can occur through issuer mint/burn and redemption, agent/custodian/VASP books, chain controls or compensating transfers, bank and payment-system processes, regulatory restrictions, and court or insolvency action. Federal law protects qualifying infrastructure settlement as final and irreversible, while payment-token customers hold a separate reserve-backed contractual claim. No complete loss-allocation and recovery series was found.

Federal law protects qualifying infrastructure settlement as final and irreversible, while payment-token customers hold a separate reserve-backed contractual claim. No complete loss-allocation and recovery series was found.

cells.text: Technical reversal, ledger correction, token burn, par redemption, licence suspension, fine, reserve claim, confiscation, adjudication and customer restitution have separate clocks.
cells.label: Technical reversal, ledger correction, token burn, par redemption, licence suspension, fine, reserve claim, confiscation, adjudication and customer restitution have separate clocks.

cells.text: Correction may occur through issuer redemption or balance-sheet repair, chain or securities-ledger action, custodian and CSD records, SIC payment processes, FINMA restoration or licence measures, and court or insolvency adjudication. Qualifying custody assets can be segregated; bank deposits have a separate CHF 100,000 protection structure; present fintech funds are not privileged or deposit-insured. SIC settlement is final and irrevocable in central-bank money.

Qualifying custody assets can be segregated; bank deposits have a separate CHF 100,000 protection structure; present fintech funds are not privileged or deposit-insured. cells.text: Technical reversal, compensating transfer, segregation, deposit payout, regulatory restoration, court claim and final cash settlement have separate clocks.
cells.label: Technical reversal, compensating transfer, segregation, deposit payout, regulatory restoration, court claim and final cash settlement have separate clocks.

cells.text: Former DASPs had to enable transfer or sale during orderly cessation. EMTs have issuer redemption and recovery-plan paths. EURXT's contract allows CACEIS Bank to block wallets, freeze tokens, blacklist addresses and recover funds under its compliance controls; those technical powers do not by themselves decide property title, finality or a contested customer's remedy. Eligible bank deposits use the separate FGDR EUR100,000 mechanism; crypto and e-money support are outside it. ETN issuer/custody claims, customer-crypto return, securities compensation, system exceptions, court claims and criminal recovery are separate again.

ETN issuer/custody claims, customer-crypto return, securities compensation, system exceptions, court claims and criminal recovery are separate again.

cells.text: Freeze, recovery, transfer, redemption, safeguarding, guarantee payout, securities claim, compensation, compensating payment and restitution have different operators, triggers and clocks.
cells.label: Freeze, recovery, transfer, redemption, safeguarding, guarantee payout, securities claim, compensation, compensating payment and restitution have different operators, triggers and clocks.

cells.text: Correction can run through PSP safeguarding and insolvency-return plans, platform/custody records, blockchain control, issuer redemption, bank and Lynx procedures, police freezing, courts and insolvency. CDIC covers eligible deposits by category but expressly excludes crypto and stablecoins.
cells.label: Correction can run through PSP safeguarding and insolvency-return plans, platform/custody records, blockchain control, issuer redemption, bank and Lynx procedures, police freezing, courts and insolvency. CDIC covers eligible deposits by category but expressly excludes crypto and stablecoins.

cells.text: Trust property, insurance proceeds, token control, compensating payment, deposit payout, recovery and restitution have different triggers and clocks.
cells.label: Trust property, insurance proceeds, token control, compensating payment, deposit payout, recovery and restitution have different triggers and clocks.

cells.text: The virtual-asset law allows a competent authority to order freezes for substantiated suspected illegality, sanctions or investigations; requires VASPs to safeguard customer assets, preserve originator and beneficiary records, screen addresses and report fraud, theft, complaints and remediation; and places unauthorized business, issuance, marketing, payments, mining facilities, ATMs and mixers under criminal penalties. Stablecoin reserves must be insolvency-segregated. Separately, payment-law safeguards, bank-resolution powers and the DGF protect different conventional claims. No reviewed evidence shows a licensed VASP insolvency, stablecoin redemption, customer-asset distribution or freeze-and-recovery case under the new law.

Stablecoin reserves must be insolvency-segregated. Separately, payment-law safeguards, bank-resolution powers and the DGF protect different conventional claims. No reviewed evidence shows a licensed VASP insolvency, stablecoin redemption, customer-asset distribution or freeze-and-recovery case under the new law.

cells.text: Address freeze, balance reduction, ledger correction, refund, safeguarded-fund claim, stablecoin reserve claim, bank resolution, deposit-guarantee payout and criminal restitution have different owners and clocks.
cells.label: Address freeze, balance reduction, ledger correction, refund, safeguarded-fund claim, stablecoin reserve claim, bank resolution, deposit-guarantee payout and criminal restitution have different owners and clocks.

catalog_context.title: Crypto around the world: many licenses, no proven cross-border use
catalog_context.answer: Across 22 jurisdictions, we found no verified cross-border payment route that depends on crypto from end to end. The token layer still settles through ordinary banks and national payment systems.
